column2: 但願你們寬容我這一點愚妄，其實你們原是寬容我的。
column3: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness; but indeed you are bearing with me.

column2: 我為你們起的憤恨，原是神那樣的憤恨。因為我曾把你們許配一個丈夫，要把你們如同貞潔的童女，獻給基督。
column3: For I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy; for I betrothed you to one husband, so that to Christ I might present you [as] a pure virgin.

column2: 我只怕你們的心或偏於邪，失去那向基督所存純一清潔的心，就像蛇用詭詐誘惑了夏娃一樣。
column3: But I am afraid that, as the serpent deceived Eve by his craftiness, your minds will be led astray from the simplicity and purity [of devotion] to Christ.

column2: 假如有人來另傳一個耶穌，不是我們所傳過的；或者你們另受一個靈，不是你們所受過的；或者另得一個福音，不是你們所得過的；你們容讓他也就罷了。
column3: For if one comes and preaches another Jesus whom we have not preached, or you receive a different spirit which you have not received, or a different gospel which you have not accepted, you bear [this] beautifully.

column2: 但我想，我一點不在那些最大的使徒以下。
column3: For I consider myself not in the least inferior to the most eminent apostles.

column2: 我的言語雖然粗俗，我的知識卻不粗俗。這是我們在凡事上向你們眾人顯明出來的。
column3: But even if I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not [so] in knowledge; in fact, in every way we have made [this] evident to you in all things.

column2: 我因為白白傳神的福音給你們，就自居卑微，叫你們高升，這算是我犯罪麼？
column3: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself so that you might be exalted, because I preached the gospel of God to you without charge?

column2: 我虧負了別的教會，向他們取了工價來給你們效力。
column3: I robbed other churches by taking wages [from] [them] to serve you;

column2: 我在你們那裡缺乏的時候，並沒有累著你們一個人；因我所缺乏的，那從馬其頓來的弟兄們都補足了。我向來凡事謹守，後來也必謹守，總不至於累著你們。
column3: and when I was present with you and was in need, I was not a burden to anyone; for when the brethren came from Macedonia they fully supplied my need, and in everything I kept myself from being a burden to you, and will continue to do so.

column2: 既有基督的誠實在我裡面，就無人能在亞該亞一帶地方阻擋我這自誇。
column3: As the truth of Christ is in me, this boasting of mine will not be stopped in the regions of Achaia.

column2: 為甚麼呢？是因我不愛你們麼？這有神知道。
column3: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows [I do]!

column2: 我現在所做的，後來還要做，為要斷絕那些尋機會人的機會，使他們在所誇的事上也不過與我們一樣。
column3: But what I am doing I will continue to do, so that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity to be regarded just as we are in the matter about which they are boasting.

column2: 那等人是假使徒，行事詭詐，裝作基督使徒的模樣。
column3: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, disguising themselves as apostles of Christ.

column2: 這也不足為怪，因為連撒但也裝作光明的天使。
column3: No wonder, for even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light.

column2: 所以他的差役，若裝作仁義的差役，也不算希奇。他們的結局必然照著他們的行為。
column3: Therefore it is not surprising if his servants also disguise themselves as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their deeds.

column2: 我再說，人不可把我看作愚妄的。縱然如此，也要把我當作愚妄人接納，叫我可以略略自誇。
column3: Again I say, let no one think me foolish; but if [you do], receive me even as foolish, so that I also may boast a little.

column2: 我說的話不是奉主命說的，乃是像愚妄人放膽自誇；
column3: What I am saying, I am not saying as the Lord would, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.

column2: 既有好些人憑著血氣自誇，我也要自誇了。
column3: Since many boast according to the flesh, I will boast also.

column2: 你們既是精明人，就能甘心忍耐愚妄人。
column3: For you, being [so] wise, tolerate the foolish gladly.

column2: 假若有人強你們作奴僕，或侵吞你們，或擄掠你們，或侮慢你們，或打你們的臉，你們都能忍耐他。
column3: For you tolerate it if anyone enslaves you, anyone devours you, anyone takes advantage of you, anyone exalts himself, anyone hits you in the face.

column2: 我說這話是羞辱自己，好像我們從前是軟弱的。然而，人在何事上勇敢，（我說句愚妄話，）我也勇敢。
column3: To [my] shame I [must] say that we have been weak [by comparison]. But in whatever respect anyone [else] is bold-- I speak in foolishness-- I am just as bold myself.

column2: 他們是希伯來人麼？我也是。他們是以色列人麼？我也是。他們是亞伯拉罕的後裔麼？我也是。
column3: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they descendants of Abraham? So am I.

column2: 他們是基督的僕人麼？（我說句狂話，）我更是。我比他們多受勞苦，多下監牢，受鞭打是過重的，冒死是屢次有的。
column3: Are they servants of Christ?-- I speak as if insane-- I more so; in far more labors, in far more imprisonments, beaten times without number, often in danger of death.

column2: 被猶太人鞭打五次，每次四十減去一下；
column3: Five times I received from the Jews thirty-nine [lashes].

column2: 被棍打了三次；被石頭打了一次，遇著船壞三次，一晝一夜在深海裡。
column3: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was stoned, three times I was shipwrecked, a night and a day I have spent in the deep.

column2: 又屢次行遠路，遭江河的危險、盜賊的危險，同族的危險、外邦人的危險、城裡的危險、曠野的危險、海中的危險、假弟兄的危險。
column3: [I have been] on frequent journeys, in dangers from rivers, dangers from robbers, dangers from [my] countrymen, dangers from the Gentiles, dangers in the city, dangers in the wilderness, dangers on the sea, dangers among false brethren;

column2: 受勞碌、受困苦，多次不得睡，又飢又渴，多次不得食，受寒冷，赤身露體。
column3: [I have been] in labor and hardship, through many sleepless nights, in hunger and thirst, often without food, in cold and exposure.

column2: 除了這外面的事，還有為眾教會掛心的事，天天壓在我身上。
column3: Apart from [such] external things, there is the daily pressure on me [of] concern for all the churches.

column2: 有誰軟弱，我不軟弱呢？有誰跌倒，我不焦急呢？
column3: Who is weak without my being weak? Who is led into sin without my intense concern?

column2: 我若必須自誇，就誇那關乎我軟弱的事便了。
column3: If I have to boast, I will boast of what pertains to my weakness.

column2: 那永遠可稱頌之主耶穌的父神知道我不說謊。
column3: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, He who is blessed forever, knows that I am not lying.

column2: 在大馬色亞哩達王手下的提督把守大馬色城，要捉拿我，
column3: In Damascus the ethnarch under Aretas the king was guarding the city of the Damascenes in order to seize me,

column2: 我就從窗戶中，在筐子裡，從城牆上被人縋下去，脫離了他的手。
column3: and I was let down in a basket through a window in the wall, and [so] escaped his hands.
